headline: CHW @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHW 4.21 at DET 4.79, with a projected total of 9.00. Movement read: Both offenses moved up (CHW +0.37, DET +0.34), so the movement is more about a higher-scoring game environment than a stronger side. The projected total climbed +0.70, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +11.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Troy Melton has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.0 ER over the last 4 outings. Batter research is strongest for Dillon Dingler, Chase Meidroth, Sam Antonacci, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jacob Gonzalez, Jahmai Jones because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
